title: Finalizer erasure phase
statement: Fix a mode, a Boolean input word $x$, an input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ allowed positions, an argument tape content $A$, an output word $o$, and a captured Boolean word $w$. Start the two-tape finalizer in state $4$, with argument tape $A$ and head at $0$, capture tape storing $w$ from cell $0$ and head at $|w|-1$, and output $o$. After exactly $|w|+1$ steps it is in state $5$, with the argument tape still $A$, the capture tape blank everywhere, both work heads at $0$, and output still $o$.
replaced:
Let the finalizer run in a fixed mode with a remaining captured word $p$. Starting from
its erasure state with the capture head at cell $|p| - 1$ (and, in install mode, the
argument head moving along with it), after exactly $|p| + 1$ steps it is in its final
silent state with the capture tape completely blank and both heads at the origin, the
output untouched.
